topics.purpose: Honestly assess whether a genuinely-new non-vacuous STRUCTURAL bridge direction remains, or the structural program is at its natural culmination (and what the single most important open question is).
topics.question: Context (established): the Window6<->codon-Q6 bridge has now (a) shown the genetic code is structurally TYPICAL for every canonical label-free codon-graph invariant beyond the edge-hiding functional e_in (fold boundaries, branch splits, quotient equitability, square 2-faces, global bypass-conductance, quotient spanning-tree -- all coincidence under maximally-conditioned nulls); (b) CERTIFIED that e_in (synonymous-edge-hiding, BC7) is the lone structural positive AND that the standard code is an e_in optimum (z=17) among degeneracy-matched codes -- connecting the abstract extremality to the classic genetic-code error-minimization optimality; (c) closed the math->bio forcing direction (both non-q6 Window6->codon embeddings fail); (d) relayed the DMS-robustness mediation test (does e_in edge-hiding buy measurable mistranslation robustness, via ProteinGym) to the empirical/bio pipeline. QUESTION: Be brutally honest and anti-numerology. Is there a genuinely-NEW, NON-VACUOUS, label-free STRUCTURAL bridge direction still worth deriving (one that is NOT a grammar-equivalent count, NOT reducible to composition/e_in, NOT q6-circular, NOT requiring external bio data), OR is the bridge's STRUCTURAL program at its natural culmination (with the remaining frontier being empirical/bio: the DMS test)? If a real structural direction remains, name the SINGLE best one with its exact invariant + null + how it escapes reduction. If not, say 'structural program complete' and state the single most important OPEN question (structural or empirical) the bridge has surfaced but not resolved.
